name: J. Lawrence Smith

relationships.evidence: Pelletreau p. 466 (Richard 5th's children include 'Judge John Lawrence')

bioAdditions: A closer route than the 5C6R on the site. Pelletreau (S2) gives his father as Richard Smith 5th (1770-1831), son of Richard 4th (d. 1811), son of Ebenezer Smith and Anna, daughter of Job Smith 2d, son of Job Smith 1st, John's 10th-great-grandfather. Path: Job 1st -> Job 2d -> Anna -> Richard 4th -> Richard 5th -> J. Lawrence, 5 generations: 4th cousin 6 times removed (also 4C7R via Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Ebenezer, and 5C6R via his mother Eliza Nicoll -> Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull). Princeton 1837; Assembly 1846; Suffolk DA 1850; county judge 1858 (S1). Wikipedia (S3) adds that his wife Sarah Nicoll Clinch was the niece and adopted daughter of the merchant A. T. Stewart, and that he was perhaps the county's largest landowner. Children: Cornelia (Mrs Prescott Hall Butler), Louise Nicoll (Mrs Frank Sayre Osborne), Kate Annette (Mrs J. Bloomfield Wetherill), Bessie Springs (Mrs Stanford White), Ella Batavia (Mrs Devereux Emmet) and James Clinch.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Paternal line fully stated in Pelletreau.
